result.title: KANLab: TensorFlow Playground for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
result.summary: KANLab is a browser-based visualization tool designed to interactively teach the core concepts of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), forked from the widely successful TensorFlow Playground. To maximize educational clarity, KANLab omits residual connections and learnable scaling parameters found in modern KAN implementations, ensuring that displayed B-spline activation curves directly correspond to their underlying trainable control points. Users can inspect and modify activation functions, initialization schemes and observe gradient descent correcting manual disruptions. Furthermore, user can explore phenomena such as activation variance, interactive pruning, and re\-/training within a compact 2D machine learning setting. KANLab is open-source and available at https://kanlab.app/

AI.brief_summary: KANLab 是基于 TensorFlow Playground 改造的浏览器可视化教学工具，用于交互展示 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络的 B 样条激活曲线、初始化与梯度下降、剪枝等概念。
AI.relevance_reason: 材料为 KAN 的教学可视化工具，未涉及视觉/多模态推理、latent 状态生成或证据使用，也无可核查的方法借鉴线索，与研究主线缺少实质联系。
